item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 10/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak and it will be warm during the day over Guangdong in the next couple of days. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be cloudier over southern China midweek this week. A cold front is expected to reach the coast of southern China during the weekend. It will become cool appreciably over the region. The associated intense northeast monsoon will bring dry and rather cool weather to the coastal areas of Guangdong early next week.

Date/Month: 11/12 (Monday)
Wind: East force 2 to 3.
Weather: Sunny intervals. One or two light rain patches in the morning and at night. Visibility relatively low in some areas at night.
Temp range: 23 - 26 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
